camel_example: aliyun quickbi-public AddWorkspaceUsers --region cn-hangzhou --WorkspaceId '95296e95-ca89-4c7d-8af9-dedf0ad00000' --RoleId 25 --UserIds de4bc5f9429141cc8091cdd1c15b0000 --version 2022-01-01 --method POST --force
description_en: Adds members to a workspace in batches
description_zh: 批量添加成员到工作空间
name: AddWorkspaceUsers

parameters.help_en:
The user IDs. These are Quick BI user IDs, not Alibaba Cloud UIDs.

You can pass multiple user IDs separated by commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
用户ID。此处为Quick BI的UserID，而非阿里云的UID。

支持批量传参，用户ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: user_ids

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the preset workspace role. Valid values:
25: storage management administrator
26: workspace developer
27: storage analysis analyst
30: workspace viewer
parameters.help_zh:
预置空间角色ID。取值范围：
25：空间管理员
26：空间开发者
27：空间分析师
30：空间查看者
parameters.name: role_id

Result.description_en: The execution result of the operation

Failure.description_en: The number of users that failed to be added

FailureDetail.example: {"2046274934845893" : "AE0150010001: This user already exists.", "1213444447906552" : "AE0150010001: This user already exists."}

Success.description_en: The number of users that were added

Total.description_en: The total number of users to be added

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:
true: The request is successful. Some members may be added successfully while others fail. For the reasons of failures, refer to FailureDetail in the response.
false: The request failed. No data is persisted
Success.description_zh:
是否请求成功。取值范围：
true：请求成功，存在添加部分成员成功，部分失败的情况，添加失败的原因参考返回结果中的FailureDetail
false：请求失败，不会持久化任何数据
